doc: stages/filters.voxeldownsize.rst: 'The input point cloud is divided into 3D voxels at the given cell size. For each populated voxel, either first point entering in the voxel or center of a voxel (depending on mode argument) is accepted and voxel is marked as populated. All other points entering in the same voxel are filtered out.' and 'cell: Cell size in the ``X``, ``Y``, and ``Z`` dimension. [Default: 0.001]'. dups.las holds 20 exact triples one unit apart; at the default cell only one point of each triple survives: 20 points with X 0..19.
